label: N8560-32C 100G data-centre switch
description: FS N8560-32C 1U 100G spine/leaf switch: 32x QSFP28 100G ports (40G or 4x25G per port, 6.4 Tbps, VXLAN/EVPN and MLAG) plus one 1G RJ-45 management port; ONIE with PicOS or another NOS. Console access is an RJ-45 serial port, not a data interface.
